content:
“Late Night” host Seth Meyers ruthlessly mocked recently reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following a whirlwind couple of weeks involving the tech giant.

While recapping Huang’s ouster and eventual reinstatement following allegations of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, Meyers pointed out one thing the tech CEO is best at ... sucking up to President Donald Trump.

Meyers then played several clips of Huang praising Trump during an appearance on “The Joe Rogan Experience” last December.

“First of all, he’s an incredibly good listener,” Huang said of Trump in one clip.

“Everything that he thinks through is very practical and very common-sense. And, you know, it’s very logical,” he said in another.

“Logical?” Meyer said. “I’m sorry, Nvidia board, you sure you can’t find someone to run the place who doesn’t think Trump is logical? Donald Trump is not exactly Spock. He’s closer to, like, a KFC spork.”

Meyers added that Huang sucks up to Trump because the tech CEO wants his protection, which he clearly got this week, as reports indicated the president spent much of the weekend pressuring Nvidia’s board of directors to reinstate Huang.

The New York Times reported that Trump’s reasoning for pushing for Huang’s reinstatement was that the president did not believe the tech CEO was a threat to national security.

Before Huang’s reinstatement, Trump had spent weeks downplaying the alleged affairs.

“Trump, for his part, wants to protect Huang because Nvidia is crucial to keeping the AI bubble alive,” Meyers said.
